Every big $PLTR  bounce since the bull cycle ended has done the same thing: trap late longs.

Last three bounces like this ended the same way: a trap.

Since breaking the weekly Fair Value Band in February, PLTR has been in a multi‑month redistribution. In most cases, that resolves lower into smart‑money pricing, not straight up.

Roughly 70% of the time, price will finish that redistribution before a real trend starts. It does not have to, but the odds are not on “this is the bottom.”

When price lives under weekly fair value, every breakout back into that level usually becomes liquidity for late longs. Retail sees “bottom.” Smart money sees exit.

Even after today’s 30%+ move on earnings, price still has not cleared and flipped weekly fair value. Until that level flips and holds, I am not sold on this breakout.

So I sit out.

If price never redistributes back to smart‑money levels, I will not take a position. That is fine. There are always other clean setups.

If I miss this move, not the end of the world. My edge is following rules, not chasing candles.
